agents.name: ingest
agents.title: Reader
agents.does: Loads the paper and what was extracted from it, and places it in your library's graph.

agents.name: priorart
agents.title: Literature scout
agents.does: Searches scholarly catalogues for work related to the paper.

agents.name: citation
agents.title: Reference checker
agents.does: Looks every reference up and reports it as found, found with mismatched details, or not found.

agents.name: statsoundness
agents.title: Statistics checker
agents.does: Recomputes reported p-values and tests whether reported means are arithmetically possible.

agents.name: overlap
agents.title: Overlap checker
agents.does: Flags passages that closely repeat another paper in your own library.

agents.name: compliance
agents.title: Venue rules checker
agents.does: Checks the paper against the target venue's submission rules.

agents.name: reproducibility
agents.title: Reproducibility checker
agents.does: Looks for public code and data, an availability statement, and a complete methods description.

agents.name: ethics
agents.title: Declarations checker
agents.does: Looks for funding, conflict-of-interest, ethics and consent statements.

agents.name: novelty
agents.title: Novelty assessor
agents.does: Compares each claimed contribution with the related work that was found.

agents.name: citation_polarity
agents.title: Citation stance reader
agents.does: Labels how the paper uses each citation: builds on it, supports it, or contrasts with it.

agents.name: taxonomy
agents.title: Theme mapper
agents.does: Groups the related work into labelled themes.

agents.name: benchmark
agents.title: Benchmark finder
agents.does: Suggests evaluation benchmarks that related work used.

agents.name: venuefit
agents.title: Venue fit assessor
agents.does: Judges whether the paper's scope matches the target venue.

agents.name: problem
agents.title: Problem statement refiner
agents.does: Sharpens your problem statement against your library and the related work found.

agents.name: tracker
agents.title: New work watcher
agents.does: Sweeps recent publications for new work on the paper's topics.

agents.name: confidence
agents.title: Confidence scorer
agents.does: Gives each claim a confidence value and an uncertainty band from the checks above.

agents.name: severity
agents.title: Triage
agents.does: Ranks every finding so you fix what matters first.

agents.name: rebuttal
agents.title: Rebuttal drafter
agents.does: Drafts a response to each reviewer concern, grounded in the paper.
